streams.negative_control_unaffected: Stated in words at the coordinator's request, and he then measured it himself: removing the fresh_context_unavailable MAP entry does NOT weaken the F12 negative control that asserts the same code is absent from the POPULATION. They are about different objects - the population is built by walking the Rust sources with cfg(test) stripped, while `mapped` is read from dist. The control continues to discriminate exactly what it did: a code reachable only under cfg(test) stays out of the population by compiler semantics rather than by an exemption list. The code itself remains in the sources unchanged, so the control keeps a real subject.
streams.owed_next_touch_of_the_harness: TWO limits the coordinator named and deliberately did not block, scheduled here so they are an obligation and not an intention. Both are fixed at the next edit of the harness, which is sub-stage 3 (No.894). (1) The brace matcher in the H1 block is QUOTE-BLIND: it counts braces with an inline IIFE that does not skip string literals. He measured the live dist - 479 string values in the region, 17 of them containing braces ({name}, {n}), ALL balanced, which is exactly why the counter lands correctly today. The drift is ASYMMETRIC and that is why it matters: a stray `}` in a future text closes the region early and late keys read inRu=0, which is LOUD; a stray `{` extends the region past the dictionary while keys still appear once and length>1000 still passes, which can pass SILENTLY with a wrong region. The cure is already in the same file - `balancedEnd(s, i, '{', '}', '"')` takes the quote character - so the IIFE is replaced by that helper. (2) The H2 parse controls sit at 0%, 41% and 56% of the map block and therefore do not bound a TAIL truncation; they are sufficient only WHILE THE MAP IS FLAT - he verified it contains no nested `};` and that the capture ends on the map's own closing brace - and they stop being sufficient the day a nested object appears. That condition goes into the code as a line of comment, not into anyone's memory.
